message: Pta nhi mujhe update krna chahiye ya nhi(most probably tum dekhogi bhi nhi:)....but....this was for u Palvika....This was the message I started writing jb main gharpe tha...it was raining much....tumhe bola tha although most probably tumhe yaad nhi hoga...My Misti Princess, My Palvika, today is Janmashtami, and baaki sbke liye it may simply be the day they celebrate the birth of Krishna, but for me, this day will always hold a completely different meaning because it is the day I first met u. I still find it beautiful how one ordinary moment can quietly become the beginning of something that means so much to you. When I first met u, I had absolutely no idea that you would become such an important part of my life, that I would one day remember tumhara little habits, ur smile, ur voice, ur stubbornness, ur cute little ways, and wo saab chote chote moments that somehow became so precious to me. I didn't know that the girl I met that day would become someone I would think about before sleeping, someone whose happiness would matter so much to me, someone with whom I would create memories that I would want to hold onto forever. Maybe that's what makes our beginning so special to me—I never planned it, never expected it, and yet somehow our paths crossed on this particular day. Janmashtami is a celebration of Krishna's arrival, and strangely enough, this day also marked the arrival of someone incredibly special into my life. I don't know what destiny had planned when we first met, but I'm grateful for whatever brought you into my world. If I could go back to that very first day knowing everything I know now, I would still choose to meet you, still choose to talk to you, and still choose to know you, because every beautiful memory that came after that moment is something I wouldn't want to lose. Whatever life brings us, I know I'll always look at Janmashtami a little differently, because somewhere between all the celebrations, lights, prayers and Krishna's stories, I'll always remember one more beautiful beginning—the day I met you. So aaj, I don't just want to wish you a Happy Janmashtami:) I want to thank this day for bringing you into my life and I want to remind you that no matter how much time passes or where life takes us, the memory of the day I first met you will always have a little corner of my heart that belongs only to you. Happy Janmashtami, Mere Misti Princess..Mere Palvika… and happy first-meeting anniversary to us. ❤️
Happy anniversary, my love. Two years and still every day feels like a new beginning with you. You have made my world softer, brighter, and kinder. I am so lucky to love you.
